originalReview.notes: Native aerial export of the Puerto Rico 2018 base. Shows the roofs and clearings at the municipality’s site. Compared roof footprints to the individual OSM polygons. This resampled view supplies plan evidence only.

quallaSearch.notes: Qualla first. Used the exact public-domain USDA interior to inform timber assembly. The supplemental U.S. National Map aerial image identifies roof groups. The municipality’s directions put the historic estate by the developed valley cluster, about 2.3 km from the GeoNames marker inherited by Qualla, which is recorded as separate locality evidence.
